translations.about.title: Let's work together
translations.about.passion: I am a frontend developer in training at the Developer Akademie. What fascinates me about programming is turning an idea into something people can click, test and use – on every screen size. I build with Angular and TypeScript, connect apps to Supabase and automate workflows with n8n.
translations.about.approach: When I face a problem, I break it into small steps, read the documentation and test each step before I move on. Every bug teaches me something about how the code really works. I like to work in a team, give honest feedback and keep my code clean, so others can build on it.

translations.legal.responsible: Responsible for the content according to § 18 (2) MStV
translations.legal.liabilityContent: I create the content of this website with care, but cannot guarantee that it is complete, correct and up to date at all times. This website links to external websites, for example GitHub and LinkedIn. Their operators alone are responsible for their content. At the time of linking, no unlawful content was apparent; if I become aware of any, I will remove the link.
translations.legal.copyrightContent: The texts, code and project images on this website are my own work. The design is based on a template of the Developer Akademie GmbH. Icons of the skill set show the logos of the respective technologies; the rights belong to their owners.
translations.privacy.title: Privacy policy
translations.privacy.controllerText: Responsible for the processing of personal data on this website is:
translations.privacy.hostingText: This website is hosted on a web server in Germany of Hetzner Online GmbH, Industriestr. 25, 91710 Gunzenhausen, Germany. When you open the website, the server automatically stores information that your browser sends: IP address, date and time of the request, the page requested, the referring page, browser type and operating system. This data is needed to deliver the website securely and to detect errors and attacks (Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR). It is deleted after seven days at the latest, unless it is needed to clarify a security incident.
translations.privacy.contactText: When you send a message through the {$START_LINK}contact form{$CLOSE_LINK}, I process your name, your email address and your message to answer your request. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR if your request concerns a possible cooperation, otherwise my legitimate interest in answering requests (Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR). I delete the data as soon as your request is settled and no legal retention periods apply.
translations.privacy.contactAbuse: The message is stored in a database on the server named above. To prevent abuse, the server also keeps a one-way hash of your IP address, which limits the number of messages per sender. Without a secret key the hash cannot be traced back to your address, and it is deleted after one hour (Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR).
translations.privacy.cookiesText: This website does not set cookies and does not use analytics or tracking tools. The fonts are stored on this server, so no connection to external font services is made.
translations.privacy.linksText: The icons for GitHub and LinkedIn are plain links. Data is only transferred to these services when you click a link; from then on, the privacy policy of the respective provider applies.
translations.privacy.rightAccess: access the data stored about you (Art. 15 GDPR),
translations.privacy.rightErasure: have your data erased or its processing restricted (Art. 17 and 18 GDPR),
translations.privacy.rightPortability: receive your data in a common format (Art. 20 GDPR),
translations.privacy.rightObjection: object to processing based on legitimate interest (Art. 21 GDPR).
translations.privacy.complaint: You can also lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority, for example the Saxon Data Protection and Transparency Commissioner.
